run_VisualizationDemo_on_image: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize instance segmentation on a single BGR image
run_VisualizationDemo_on_video: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize detections on each frame of a video file
create_AsyncPredictor_for_parallel_infer: create an AsyncPredictor with multiple GPU workers to run model inference asynchronously in parallel
use_AsyncPredictor_put_get: use AsyncPredictor put and get methods to enqueue images and retrieve predictions in order
shutdown_AsyncPredictor_workers: shutdown all AsyncPredictor worker processes by sending stop tokens to the task queue
